frozen_before: any neural training or prediction result exists for this project
source: the proposed defaults in config/phases.json, adopted unchanged

exit_tests.threshold: learned predictor RMSE at least 20% below the best baseline at every horizon 1..10 steps
Spearman(predicted std, |error|) >= 0.5 and 90% interval coverage within +/- 10 points
learned-model MPC success non-inferior to nominal within 5 points, or a reported negative result
exit_tests.decision_rule: On m1-suite-1, learned-model success minus nominal-model success is at least -5 points as a point estimate, with its paired interval reported. An undecided episode counts as not successful and is reported.

exit_tests.threshold: AUROC >= 0.75 for predicting a constraint violation; abstention rate and coverage reported
